SessionStart.description: Ensure ~/.claude/settings.json cleanupPeriodDays >= 90 (guarded by 7-day timestamp flag) and set default statusline when none is configured

hooks.description: NDF: set default statusline when none is configured

hooks.command: sh -c 'ROOT="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}"; if [ -n "$ROOT" ]; then node "$ROOT/scripts/slack-notify.js" session_end; fi; exit 0'
hooks.description: Send Slack notification when Claude Code exits
